required_fixes: Redesign session_invalidation variance mechanism to avoid TP dilution: current 50/50 coin flip mixes valid sessions (behavioral=0) under drift label, guaranteeing TP=0.43-0.47 and mean_tp=0.729 <0.85, Wilson lower ~0.27-0.30 <0.75, causing C1_drift_tp FAIL. Fix: vary session_status_check intensity while keeping session_change=1 for all drift samples (e.g., vary /session/status response latency, body field, or graded TTL expiry window that still yields 401 but with variable session_status_check weight), or define TP threshold to include session_status_check contribution, or preregister separate TP thresholds per drift pattern.

Align prereg-specified stochastic variation with execution: prereg 6.4 and spec measurement_validity specify random session TTL 5-15s + token expiry jitter +-1s for session_invalidation, but execution uses post-creation 50/50 invalidate coin flip plus +-1/3600h jitter. Implement actual TTL-based expiry (sleep or mocked clock) or amend prereg to coin-flip model and bound ceiling to synthetic bimodal variance (std~2.49) not continuous TTL.

Correct noise-only sample size to prereg/spec estimated_cost: spec states 8 noise-only x30=240 null samples, result uses 4 patterns x30=120. Align prereg, execution, and result reporting, or explicitly document 120 denominator for C4_null_control. FP=0.0 passes at 120 but power/CI differs (Wilson upper 0.030 vs 0.015).

Increase per-condition power or preregister pooled-only primary: n=30 yields per-condition Pearson r CIs wide (e.g., r=-0.319 p=0.086, r=0.313 p=0.092) and non-significant for all 8 conditions. Pooled n=240 is adequate for |r|=0.139 detection (p=0.031), but per-condition exploratory claims remain underpowered. Consider n>=60 per condition or state per-condition analysis is exploratory only.

Isolate structural signal for response_time_jitter: current structural_std 0.93-0.98 for jitter conditions arises from seed change across baseline/current schema generations (baseline is previous iteration's schema), not from jitter itself which applies no schema modification. Fix baseline capture to be deterministic given seed (e.g., generate both schemas from same seed) so jitter structural is 0 by design, or document that structural variance for jitter is artifactual seed drift not noise-pattern effect.

Narrow product consequence scope: C3 |r|<0.3 passes but C1 fails, so overall decision_rule requires FAIL. Do not claim product pipeline gains validated second detection channel until C1-C4 pass jointly. Next design must achieve C2 variance without breaking C1, per parent handoff recommendation to either fix /session/status probing or restrict confirmatory test to permission_boundary-only (n=120, r=0.051).

Preserve frozen C3 conjunctive threshold (|r|<0.3 AND permutation p<0.05): producer correctly applies it (r=0.1387 p=0.031 PASS). Do not relax p threshold post hoc; report permission_boundary-only r=0.051 p=0.577 and session_invalidation-only r=0.189 p=0.038 as exploratory, not confirmatory, until preregistered.

validity_findings.finding: C1_drift_tp correctly FAILS per frozen rule: mean_tp=0.729 <0.85 and all_wilson_lower_above_075=false (4/8 conditions Wilson lower 0.27-0.30). Root cause is 50/50 session validity randomization: session_invalidation samples with coin_flip valid have token_validation_failures=0, session_state_changes=0, auth_boundary_shifts=0, session_status_code=200 -> behavioral_composite=0.0, counted as false negative. This dilutes TP to 0.433-0.467 for SI conditions vs 1.0 for PB conditions. Parent EXP-GRAPH-35191029030 had TP=1.0 for SI when always invalidated. The variance fix directly trades off detection performance by labeling non-drift as drift.

Structural composite for response_time_jitter conditions shows std 0.928-0.977 (structural_std) and mean 3.66-3.73, yet mock_server.py apply_noise_to_schema for response_time_jitter does pass (schema unchanged). claim_ceiling: MAXIMUM JUSTIFIED: No overall PASS. Frozen decision_rule FAIL due to C1_drift_tp (mean 0.729 <0.85, Wilson lower 0.27-0.30 <0.75) despite measurement VALID (8/8 variance, n=240). Descriptive ceilings only: (1) /session/status probing with 50/50 coin-flip variance achieves PC_SESSION_STATUS_VARIANCE 4/4 and C2 8/8, confirming unauthenticated /schema + authenticated /session/status can co-observable behavioral and structural signals on deterministic Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT HS256 localhost, but variance model is bimodal Bernoulli (std~2.49) not TTL 5-15s; (2) Pooled orthogonality |r|=0.1387 (|r|<0.3, perm p~0.031) survives in isolation on pooled 240, but is heterogeneous (PB 0.051 p=0.577, SI 0.189 p=0.038, per-condition |r| 0.10-0.32 all p>0.08) and does not support product pipeline parallel independent channels because drift detection fails when variance is induced this way; (3) Null control FP=0.0 on 120 noise-only samples replicates, but denominator half of prereg 240; (4)does NOT support: general orthogonality across drift families, real OAuth/OIDC middleware, production APIs with DB/cache/CDN/latency, or C-FRESHNESS VALIDATED. C-FRESHNESS remains EXPERIMENTAL (parent EXP-GRAPH-35166507358) with this narrow descriptive replication of PB orthogonality; SI orthogonality remains confounded by TP/variance trade-off. Obtain PASS requires redesigned SI variance that preserves TP >=0.85.
